prompt: A checkpointed implementation added support for the second first-party seed synthesis agent and its matching intake template. A regression removed that support, the tests, and the docs. Restore the prior checkpointed behavior and keep the agent invocation isolated from project configuration.

setup_replacements.old: cmd.Flags().StringVar(&seedOpts.agent, "agent", "none", "Agent synthesis mode: none, command, codex, or claude-code")
setup_replacements.new: cmd.Flags().StringVar(&seedOpts.agent, "agent", "none", "Agent synthesis mode: none, command, or codex")

setup_replacements.old: cmd.Flags().StringVar(&refreshOpts.seed.agent, "agent", "none", "Agent synthesis mode for seed: none, command, codex, or claude-code")
setup_replacements.new: cmd.Flags().StringVar(&refreshOpts.seed.agent, "agent", "none", "Agent synthesis mode for seed: none, command, or codex")

setup_commands: perl -0pi -e 's/\|codex\|claude-code\|command/\|codex\|command/g; s/entire brain seed --agent claude-code \.\n//g; s/- `templates\/entire-brain-intake-claude-agent.md`\n//g' README.md docs/seed_plan.md
validation: test $(rg -n 'claude-code' README.md docs/seed_plan.md internal/cli/refresh.go internal/cli/seed.go internal/cli/seed_test.go | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -ge 8
